आरंभ करने में विफल रहे हैं या इस आधार पर कि कम्पनी पूर्ववर्ती 2 वित्तीय वर्षों से कारोबार नहीं कर पाई है और इस अवधि के भीतर कम्पनी

2. इसके द्वारा यह सूचित किया जाता है कि कम्पनी अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 248 (2) के तहत कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार को उपर्युक्त 


कम्पनियों के नाम कम्पनी रजिस्टर से इस आधार पर नाम हटाने का आवेदन प्राप्त हुआ है कि कम्पनी के निगमन के एक वर्ष के भीतर कारोबार 
आरंभ करने में विफल रहे हैं या इस आधार पर कि कम्पनी पूर्ववर्ती 2 वित्तीय वर्षों से कारोबार नहीं कर पाई है और इस अवधि के भीतर कम्पनी 
अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 455 के तहत निष्क्रिय कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त करने का आदेश का आवेदन नहीं किया है या कम्पनी ने निष्क्रिय 
कम्पनी की स्थिति प्राप्त कर ली है, पर वे कम्पनी के रूप में पंजीकरण नहीं रखना चाहते और अतः कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से अपना/अपने नाम हटाने 
का अनुरोध किया है। 


3. तदनुसार, कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार उपर्युक्त कम्पनियों के नामों को कम्पनियों के रजिस्टर से हटाने का प्रस्ताव करता है | 
4. यदि किसी व्यक्ति/संस्था को कम्पनी को कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रार से कम्पनियों का नाम हटाने के प्रस्ताव से आपत्ति है तो वह व्यक्ति/संस्था

G.S.R. 140.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Ministry of Home Affairs, Library Information Assistant Recruitment (Amendments) Rules, 2016, 
except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the 
following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Library and Information Assistant in the Ministry 
of Home Affairs, namely:- 


1. Short title and commencement.— (1) These rules may be called the Ministry of Home Affairs, Library and 
Information Assistant (Group “B’ Post) Recruitment Rules, 2026. 

(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 

2. Number of post, classification and level in pay matrix.— The number of the said post, its classification and 


level in the pay matrix attached thereto, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these 
10165. 


3, Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.-_ The method of recruitment, age-limit, 
qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said 
Schedule. 


4. Disqualification.— No person,- 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 


shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the 
personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so 
doing, exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 


5. | Power to relax. Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the Union Public Service 
Commission, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons.

done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment 
to the post of Library and Information Assistant in the Economics, Statistics and Evaluation Division in the 
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, namely: -

Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Economics, Statistics and Evaluation Division, Library and

these rules.

limit, qualifications and other matters relating thereto, shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the Schedule. 


4. Disqualification.- No person, 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 


(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible 
for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
such person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax.- Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order, for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the Union Public Service Commission, 
relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


6. Saving.- Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions 
required to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the ex- 
Servicemen and other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government 
from time to time in this regard.

New Delhi, the 23rd July, 2026 


G.S.R. 142.—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the constitution and in 
supersession of the Central Water Commission Draftsman Grade I (Non-Ministerial Group ‘B’ Post) Recruitment Rules, 
2001 and the Central Water Commission Non-Ministerial Group ‘C’ posts (Engineering Services) Recruitment Rules, 2002 
in so far as it relates to the post of Draftsman Grade II and Draftsman Grade III, except as respects things done or omitted to 
be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to 
the post of Senior Draughtsman in Central Water Commission under the Department of Water Resources, River 
Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, namely :- 


1. Short title and commencement. — (1) These rules may be called the Department of Water Resources, River 
Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Central Water Commission, Senior Draughtsman, Recruitment Rules, 2026. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. Number of posts, classification and level in pay matrix. — The number of post, its 


classification and level in the pay matrix attached thereto, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule 
annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc. —The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications 
and other matters relating thereto, shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. — No person, — 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the 
personal law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so 
doing, exempt any person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. — Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, by 
order, for reasons to be recorded in writing and in consultation with the Union Public Service Commission, relax any of 
the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. - Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required to 
be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the Ex-servicemen and 
other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to 
time in this regard.

(Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying) 
New Delhi, the 27th July, 2026 


G.S.R. 143.— In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution and in 
supersession of the Delhi Milk Scheme, Junior Accounts Officer Recruitment Rules, 1999 and the Delhi Milk Scheme 
(Accountant and Cashier Group ‘C’) Recruitment Rules,1996, in so far as they relate to the post of Accountant, 
except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession, the President hereby makes the 
following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Junior Accounts Officer in Delhi Milk Scheme 
under the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying in the Ministry of Fisheries, namely:- 


1. Short title and commencement.- (1) These rules may be called the Delhi Milk Scheme, Junior Accounts 
Officer, Recruitment Rules, 2026. 

(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 

2. Number of post, classification and level in pay matrix.- The number of post, its classification and level in 


this pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit, other qualifications, etc. — The method of recruitment, age-limit, 
qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said 
Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. — No person, - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living, or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 


shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government, may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. — Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any 
class or category of persons. 


6. Saving. — Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required 
to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the Ex-servicemen and 
other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time 
in this regard.

ELECTION COMMISSION OF INDIA 
ORDER 
New Delhi, the 18th June, 2026 


O.N. 80.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Haryana, 2024 for 14-Pehowa 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/ECI/HAR- 
LA/2024, dated 5" September, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at an 
election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned election for 14-Pehowa Assembly Constituency of Haryana, 
2024 was declared by the Returning Officer on 80 October, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account of 
Election Expenses was 7 November, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Kurukshetra report dated 09.11.2024 forwarded by 
the Chief Electoral Officer, Haryana vide his letter no. 6/Elect-Exp./GELA-HR-2024/Elec-2025/2AE-692 dated 
05.02.2025, under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Kuldeep Singh a contesting 
candidate from 14-Pehowa Assembly Constituency of state of Haryana has failed to lodge account of election 
expenses, as required under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Kurukshetra a Show-Cause 
notice No. 76/HR-LA/Exp. Account/2024/CEMS-I, dated 30% April, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 
of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Kuldeep Singh for not lodging 
of his account of Election Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct 
of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Kuldeep Singhwas directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Kurukshetra District within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Kurukshetra vide his letter no. Elec-2025/442 dated 11.06.2025 
has informed that the notice was duly served and received by Sh. Kuldeep Singh’s son (name Yugraj) on 
14.05.2025; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Kurukshetra in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. Elec- 
2025/443 dated 13.06.2025 has reported that Sh. Kuldeep Singhhas not submitted account of election expenses. 
Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Kuldeep Singh has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the 
Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that: - 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or 
under this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in 
the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three 
years from the date of the order.’’; 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Kuldeep Singh 
has failed to lodge account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 

NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Kuldeep Singh, 488, Murtzapur, Haryana, a contesting 
candidate for 14-Pehowa Assembly Constituency of Haryana in General Election to Legislative Assembly, 2024 to 
be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the Parliament or the Legislative 
Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three years from the date of this 
order.

New Delhi, the 14th July, 2026 

O.N. 83.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Haryana, 2024 for 74-Rewari 
Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification No. 464/ECI/HAR- 
LA/2024, dated 5" September, 2024; and 

WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at 
an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his/her election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him/her or his/her 
election agent under Section 77 of the said act; and 

WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned election from 74-Rewari Assembly Constituency of 
Haryana, was declared by the Returning Officer on 8 October, 2024 and hence the last date for lodging the account 
of Election Expenses was 7 November, 2024; and 

WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Rewari forwarded by the Chief Electoral Officer, Haryana 
vide his letter no. 6/Elect-Exp./GELA-HR-2024/Elec-2025/2AE-692 dated 05.02.2025, under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 
of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Ranbir Singh a contesting candidate from 74-Rewari Assembly 
Constituency has failed to lodge account of election expenses, as required under law; and 
WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Rewari a Show-Cause notice No. 

76/HR-LA/Exp. Account/2024/CEMS-I, dated 30% April, 2025 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the 
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Ranbir Singh for not lodging of his 
account of Election Expenses; and 


200 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : AUGUST 8, 2026/ SHRAVAN 17, 1948 [PART II—SEc. 3(iii)] 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Ranbir Singh was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission 
explaining the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District 
Election Officer, Rewari within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Rewari vide his letter no. Elec-2025/711 dated 16.06.2025 has 
informed that the notice was duly served and received by Sh. Ranbir Singh’s son (name Devendra) on 21.05.2025; 
and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Rewari in his Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. Elec- 
2025/711 dated 16.06.2025 has reported that Sh. Ranbir Singh has not submitted account of election expenses. 
Further, after receipt of the said notice, Sh. Ranbir Singh has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the 
Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the account of his election expenses as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that: - 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, the Election Commission shall, by order published in the 
Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such person shall be disqualified for a period of three years 
from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Ranbir Singh 
has failed to lodge account of his election expenses and has no good reason or justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Ranbir Singh, Village-Budani, P.O.-Turkiawas, District 
Rewari, Haryana, a contesting candidate from 74-Rewari Assembly Constituency of Haryana in General Election 
to Legislative Assembly, 2024 to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House of the 
Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of three 
years from the date of this order.

ORDER 
New Delhi, the 14th July, 2026 


O.N. 84.—WHEREAS, the General Election to Legislative Assembly of Rajasthan, 2023 for 
47-Amer Assembly Constituency was held in pursuance of the Election Commission of India Notification 
No.464/RJ-LA/2023, dated 30" October, 2023; and 


WHEREAS, as per Section 78 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, every contesting candidate at 
an election shall, within 30 days from the date of election of the returned candidate, lodge with the District Election 
Officer an account of his election expenses which shall be true copy of the account kept by him or his election agent 
under Section 77 of the said act; and 


WHEREAS, the result of the above-mentioned election from 47-Amer Assembly Constituency of 
Rajasthan, 2023 was declared by the Returning Officer on 37१ December, 2023 and hence the last date for lodging the 
account of Election Expenses was 27 January, 2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the report submitted by DEO, Jaipur report dated 04.01.2024 forwarded by the Chief 
Electoral Officer, Rajasthan vide his letter no. F.3(1)(5)EEM/ELECTION/Candidates’ Exp./433 dated 16.01.2024, 
under sub-rule (1) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Vinod Jat a contesting candidate from 47- 
Amer Assembly Constituency of state of Rajasthan has failed to lodge his account of election expenses, as required 
under law; and 


WHEREAS, on the basis of the said report of the District Election Officer, Jaipur a Show-Cause notice No. 
76/RJ-LA/47/2023/CEMS-I, dated 19 March, 2024 was issued under sub rule (5) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961 by the Election Commission of India to Sh. Vinod Jat for not lodging of account of Election 
Expenses; and 


WHEREAS, through the above said Show Cause Notice and under sub rule (6) of Rule 89 of the Conduct of 
Elections Rules, 1961, Sh. Vinod Jat was directed to submit representation in writing to the Commission explaining 
the reasons for not lodging the account and also to lodge account of election expenses with the District Election 
Officer, Jaipur within 20 days from the date of receipt of the notice; and 


WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Jaipur vide his letter no. 
Ele./L.Gen.Ele./2024/2094 dated 13.04.2024 has informed that the notice was duly served and received by Smt. 
Badam Choudhary, wife of Sh. Vinod Jat on dated 03.04.2024; and 


WHEREAS, as per the supplementary report submitted by DEO, Jaipur dated 13.08.2024 forwarded by the 
Chief Electoral Officer, Rajasthan vide his letter no. F.3(1)(5)EEM/ELECTION/Candidates’ Exp./8511 dated 
21.08.2024, has reported that Sh. Vinod Jat submitted his incomplete account of election expenses, as required under 
law, and submitted the same beyond the prescribed time limit; and 


WHEREAS, The Election Commission of India directed the DEO, Jaipur, vide its letter dated 02.01.2025 
and reminder dated 25.03.2025, to ask the candidate to submit his complete accounts of election expenditure, 
including vouchers, registers, details of bank accounts, etc., as prescribed under the law; and 


WHEREAS, as per the second supplementary report submitted by DEO, Jaipur dated 19.03.2025 
forwarded by the Chief Electoral Officer, Rajasthan vide his letter no. F.3(1)(5)EEM/ELECTION/Candidates’ 
Exp./2023/1490 dated 01.04.2025, has reported that Sh. Vinod Jat still has not submitted his incomplete account 
of election expenses, as required under the law, even after personally receiving the letter/notice on 10.03.2025; and 


WHEREAS, due to the delayed submission and incomplete of the accounts, the Election Commission of 
India vide its letter no. 76/Raj-LA/40-49/2023/CEMS-1, dated 30.01.2026 directed Sh. Vinod Jat to submit complete 
accounts of election expenditure, including all supporting vouchers, and also to explain the reasons for the delay in 
filing the said accounts before the District Election Officer; and

WHEREAS, the District Election Officer, Jaipur in his third Supplementary Report, vide its letter no. F 
election/2026/1199 dated 01.04.2026 reported that Sh. Vinod Jat has not submitted the account of his election 
expenses in the manner required as he failed to submit vouchers of election expenses, as required under law. Further, 
after receipt of the Commission’s letter dated 30.01.2026 (received by his wife Smt. Badam Choudhary), Sh. Vinod 
Jat has neither furnished any reason nor explanation to the Election Commission of India, for failure to lodge the 
account of his election expenses in the manner as prescribed under law; and 


WHEREAS, Section 10 A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 provides that:- 
“If the Election Commission is satisfied that a person- 


(a) has failed to lodge an account of election expenses, within the time and in the manner required by or under 
this Act, and 


(b) has no good reason or justification for the failure, 


the Election Commission shall, by order published in the Official Gazette, declare him to be disqualified and any such 
person shall be disqualified for a period of three years from the date of the order.”’; 


WHEREAS, on the basis of facts and available records, the Commission is satisfied that Sh. Vinod Jat has 
failed to lodge his account of election expenses in the manner required under law and has no good reason or 
justification for the failure to do so; and 


NOW, THEREFORE, in pursuance of Section 10A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, the 
Election Commission of India hereby declares Sh. Vinod Jat, 43, Gram Naradpura, Tehsil-Jamwaramgarh, 
District-Jaipur, Rajasthan, a contesting candidate from 47-Amer Assembly Constituency of Rajasthan in General 
Election to Legislative Assembly, 2023 to be disqualified for being chosen as and for being a member of either House 
of the Parliament or the Legislative Assembly or the Legislative Council of a State or Union Territory for a period of 
three years from the date of this order.
